fixtureBoundaries: Actual TECH and TEAM_LEADER credentials with original role guards. Actual today API returns four visits belonging to the technician; original completion filter produces three cards. A tampered technician query does not expose the private other technician visit.

The original page reads today visits, not an unlimited historical archive. endAt/startAt/plannedDate/date precedence, valid pt-PT date format, Invalid Date literal and original endAt-or-DONE completion filter remain unchanged.

Actual client/pool values identical to Portuguese fallback stay literal in every language. Markup-like names and long source words are escaped and wrapped. Raw status codes, server error/message and cloned Error.message/name remain literal.

Read adaptations cover missing/invalid dates and names, empty complete list, complete false, total mismatch, visits not array, HTTP503 non-JSON own fallback and raw server errors. They do not change authorization or operational sources.
Held loading response uses previously captured JSON from the actual API with one gated delivery and no extra route.fetch socket. Original producer is resumed; language repaint calls no producer.

Original catch fallback is reached once with an empty transport Error.message; QA wrapper is restored. A valid-role/id0 session follows the original missing-technician branch without bypassing its guard.

Main context uses real worker/cache and real offline: an in-memory list is preserved; cached-shell reload has no invented history-list cache and retains the raw browser transport error. Returning to actual offline REGULAR/EXTRA restores thirteen typed fields each.

Two same-ID REGULAR/EXTRA pending requests retain UUID/payload hashes, all field storage/session, token/user fields excluding language, nodes/text nodes/focus/handlers and SQL. Only existing language PUT is allowed; zero operational writes.
TEAM_LEADER enters with the original role grant and actual API empty list. No foreign technician records are shown.
discardedQaProbes: Initial long source pool exposed overflow; final item CSS wraps arbitrary source words.
Held-response cleanup release moved to outer scope so a failed assertion can release the response in finally.
